name: bun-blinkit-mcp
description: API-only Blinkit MCP server (TypeScript + Bun). Search, build a cart and prepare checkout on live blinkit.com. No browser, no automated payments.
long_description:
Better Blinkit MCP lets you shop on Blinkit from your AI assistant without any browser automation.

**How it works**
- Talks directly to Blinkit's consumer-web JSON API over HTTPS (Cloudflare TLS-fingerprint bypass via impit). No Playwright/Chromium is ever launched.
- Headless phone + OTP login; the session token is stored locally.

**Key features**
- Confirm a delivery location before anything else (hard location guard)
- Search products, autosuggest, recommendations, multi-factor best pick
- Stateful working cart priced against Blinkit in real time
- Named custom combos and staples, persisted in a local SQLite database, for repeat orders
- Saved addresses and checkout preparation
- Order history stored locally for repeat-purchase suggestions

**Payments are intentionally NOT automated.** The assistant can prepare and validate an order, then hands off to you to pay and confirm in the Blinkit app or website.

Unofficial and not affiliated with Blinkit/Grofers.
